title: Widgets
body: The app is really nice looking but it promises widgets when you bought premium but there is no widget option after that.
author: souckovanika

title: Scam
body:
Paid for a premium then got a new phone and while it says my purchase has been restored it isn’t! 
They stole the price of a yearly subscription! 

Will be reporting this app to Apple.
author: Michael_Nijio
